guidelinesCompliance.evidence: All public wrappers, constructors, accessors, collection methods, and error variants in src/features/weekly_radar/domain/top5_weekly_read_model.rs have Rust documentation comments.

guidelinesCompliance.guideline: Treat all Top5 fields as supplied upstream facts; do not calculate or infer Stage, Direction, Confidence, Key Change, Distance, or membership.
guidelinesCompliance.evidence: Top5Entry stores candidate, company, stage, direction, confidence, key_change, and next unchanged; Top5WeeklyReadModel only checks candidate identity/capacity and appends in input order, with no Stage, Direction, Confidence, Key Change, Distance, or membership calculation.

guidelinesCompliance.guideline: Preserve supplied entry order and exact nonblank text values.
guidelinesCompliance.evidence: The read model appends entries without sorting, and non_empty rejects only blank-only text while retaining every accepted value exactly; focused tests cover order and exact retention.

guidelinesCompliance.guideline: Use candidate identity for duplicate detection and reject duplicates deterministically.

guidelinesCompliance.guideline: Do not modify shared Weekly Radar module registration or architecture guard files; the parent composition Work Item owns those paths.

guidelinesCompliance.guideline: Do not add dependencies or import internal modules from other features.
